tools.name: glass-carver-20261023.json
tools.description: Turn a real animal scan into a little cut-crystal animal: one watertight solid, re-cut into a few hundred flat facets with a hair of bevel (or polished smooth), the Rainbow Maker's three-colour glass for Blender renders, an FBX for Unity, and a record of the scan's source and licence. Made for Liminal Doors' glass animals, one behind every door; LiminalGlassAnimals.cs places them with the LiminalDoors/Crystal shader.
tools.command_template: blender --background --python scripts/glass-carver/glass-carver-20261023.py -- --scan "<scan-file>" --name <Animal> --out "<project-path>/Assets/LiminalDoors/GlassAnimals" --height 0.22 --style cut --source "<where the scan came from>" --licence "<its licence>" --render
